questions.question: The Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) 2011 (Rural) of India allows ranking of the households under 'Others' category based on their status on _______ deprivation parameters.

• The SECC 2011 was conducted to identify households living below the poverty line and to gather socio-economic data for effective policy-making.
 
• The deprivation parameters include criteria such as households with only one room with kucha walls and roof, no adult member between ages 16 to 59, female-headed households with no adult male member aged 16 to 59, among others.
 
• This ranking helps in the identification of the most vulnerable and disadvantaged households for targeted welfare schemes and programs.

• The data collected through SECC 2011 has been used to create a database of eligible beneficiaries for various government programs such as the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY), National Food Security Act (NFSA), and others.

questions.question: During which religious event in India do devotees take a holy dip in the Ganges River, believing it washes away their sins, and perform various rituals at the riverbanks?

__
 
• **Kumbh Mela** is a major pilgrimage and festival in Hinduism, held every 12 years at four river-bank pilgrimage sites: Prayagraj, Haridwar, Nashik, and Ujjain.

• The festival is marked by mass gatherings of pilgrims, sadhus, and saints, who perform various rituals and prayers on the riverbanks.
 
• Kumbh Mela is recognized as an Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Kumbh Mela is held at each of the four locations in a cycle of approximately 12 years, based on specific astrological alignments.
 
• The exact dates of the Kumbh Mela are determined according to the Hindu calendar.
 
• The festival is one of the largest peaceful gatherings in the world and is an important part of Hindu culture and spirituality.
 
• In addition to the religious significance, Kumbh Mela also serves as a social and cultural event, attracting millions of people from around the globe.

questions.question: With respect to money and banking, what does SLR stand for?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Statutory Liquidity Ratio**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR)** is a requirement for commercial banks to maintain a certain percentage of their net demand and time liabilities (NDTL) in the form of liquid assets.
 
• The SLR is mandated by the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** to ensure the liquidity and solvency of banks.
 
• Assets that qualify for SLR include cash, gold, and government-approved securities.
 
• The SLR is a tool used by the RBI to control the expansion of credit and manage inflation in the economy.
 
• Changes in the SLR can affect the lending capacity of banks, influencing the overall economic activity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Statutory Liquidity Ratio** is different from the **Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR)**, which requires banks to keep a certain percentage of their NDTL in cash with the RBI.
 
• The SLR is determined under the **Banking Regulation Act, 1949**.
 
• As of recent times, the SLR has been adjusted periodically based on the economic conditions and policy objectives of the RBI.
 
• Maintaining the SLR ensures that banks have sufficient liquid assets to meet depositor demands and contingencies.
 
• The SLR also helps in controlling the credit growth in the economy, thereby influencing inflation and economic stability.

questions.question: Which of the following classical dance form is associated with Kerala?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohiniyattam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is a classical dance form from Kerala, India.
 
• It is known for its graceful and feminine movements, often performed as a solo recital by women.
 
• The dance form is deeply rooted in the **Lasya** style, which represents the feminine and tender aspects of dance.
 
• Mohiniyattam combines elements of **Bharatanatyam** and **Kathakali**, two other major classical dance forms from Southern India.
 
• The word "Mohiniyattam" comes from "Mohini," a female avatar of the Hindu god Vishnu, and "attam," meaning dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kerala** is also home to other classical dance forms like **Kathakali** and **Theyyam**.
 
• Mohiniyattam costumes are traditionally white or off-white with gold borders, known as **Kasavu** sarees.
 
• The dance form has a rich repertoire of **stories from Hindu mythology**, often focusing on the themes of love and devotion.
 
• Mohiniyattam was revived in the 20th century by the efforts of artists and scholars who aimed to preserve this cultural heritage.
 
• It is recognized as one of the eight classical dance forms of India by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.

questions.question: The first five-year plan of India was based on which model?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Harrod-Domar Model**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first five-year plan of India was based on the **Harrod-Domar Model**.
 
• The **Harrod-Domar Model** is a classical economic theory which suggests that the growth rate of an economy is directly related to the level of savings and the productivity of investment.
 
• This model was chosen as it emphasized the importance of investment and savings to spur economic growth, which was crucial for India's development post-independence.
 
• The first five-year plan, spanning from 1951 to 1956, focused on the agricultural sector, aiming to increase food production and address the food shortages of the time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Five-Year Plans** were central to India's planned economic development strategy, with the Planning Commission playing a key role in formulating and overseeing their implementation.
 
• The **Planning Commission** was established in 1950 and was responsible for assessing the country's resources, formulating plans for their most effective and balanced utilization, and determining priorities.
 
• The success of the first five-year plan set the foundation for subsequent plans, which continued to shape India's economic policies and strategies for decades.
 
• Over time, the focus of the five-year plans shifted from agriculture to industrialization, infrastructure development, and later, to social sectors such as education and health.
 
• In 2015, the Planning Commission was replaced by the **NITI Aayog**, which now serves as the policy think-tank of the Government of India, providing strategic and technical advice on key policy matters.

questions.question: Who is the presiding officer of the Rajya Sabha (Council of States) in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vice President**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The presiding officer of the Rajya Sabha (Council of States) in India is the **Vice President**.
 
• The Vice President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
 
• In the absence of the Vice President, the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha presides over the sessions.
 
• The Vice President is elected by an electoral college consisting of members of both houses of Parliament.
 
• The Vice President's role in the Rajya Sabha is crucial for maintaining order and decorum during debates and ensuring the smooth functioning of the house.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Rajya Sabha** is the upper house of India's bicameral Parliament, with representatives elected by the elected members of State Legislative Assemblies and Electoral college for Union Territories.
 
• The Rajya Sabha represents the states and union territories of India and ensures federal equilibrium by protecting the interests of the states.
 
• The **Vice President** serves a term of five years but can be re-elected any number of times.
 
• The Vice President can also act as the President of India when there is a vacancy in the office of the President or when the President is unable to discharge his/her duties.
 
• The Rajya Sabha cannot be dissolved, and it is a permanent body, with one-third of its members retiring every two years.
